Unlike neighboring pollutants, this row omits an MQL while listing finite aquatic criteria (28 and 6.6 µg/l); whether the blank MQL implies no method quantitation requirement, inherits a default, or leaves monitoring undefined would change limit applicability, monitoring obligation evaluation, and missing-evidence classification for this parameter.

The TMDL-need column is shown alongside numeric criteria; whether 'Need TMDL' signals an additional enforceable limit source, a planning flag only, or a monitoring trigger would change which limits are considered applicable and whether TMDL-related monitoring is in scope.

Every listed pollutant row ends with N/A in the TMDL-need column; reading N/A as 'no TMDL limit applies,' 'not assessed,' or 'data not available' would change whether TMDL-based limits or obligations are included versus left unresolved.
